CustomField.description: Indicates if the document submitted by the customer is of the approved list of documents by the bank
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check that the customer has provided a current Australian identity document, and it is one of the following: 1) Passport, 2) Driver's License, 3) Birth Certificate, 4) Marriage Certificate, 5) Change of Name Certificate. Also ensure that the document is an original (not a certified copy), and it shows no signs of tampering or malicious altering. For samples of accepted documents refer to the procedural guide.
